user.title: Connect a room microphone to Belle
user.description: In Belmelo, open Ask Belle → More options → Room microphones. Choose the room and shared voice access, then copy its ten-minute pairing code here. Select the M5Stack microphone that will use this room profile.

error.cannot_connect: Pairing could not be completed. Check the code, enabled AI choices and home connection in Belmelo.

abort.reconfigured: This microphone's Belle connection has been updated.
